observations.evidence: Fresh load of /projects/910000000003001?tab=overview at 1280x720 showed no project calendar text or .el-calendar DOM; the overview contained 主计划甘特图 and 子计划甘特图, each with one rendered canvas.
The main chart displayed month labels (2026年8月, 2026年9月, 2026年10月). The child chart displayed weekly labels (第31周 onward), with 主计划 rows above 子计划 rows and visible status/progress bars.
At 1280px viewport the child chart scroll container measured clientWidth 894 and scrollWidth 1034 while body/document scrollWidth remained 1280, proving overflow stayed inside the chart container.
A fresh page load contained only normal Vite connecting/connected debug messages and no runtime error.

coverage_note: The in-app browser session could not be resized and remained 1280x720 even when a mobile size was requested; mobile runtime sampling is therefore unavailable. Responsive CSS and chart-local scroll rules were checked statically.
residual_risks: Verify at 375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 in a resizable browser before production release.
